clues.text: Riders plunge from a height of 164 feet and reach speeds of 70 mph on this thrill machine, which delivers tons of airtime with zero inversions.
Engineered by Swiss manufacturer Intamin, this steel coaster made its official debut in 2021.
This coaster operates in the European nation of Belgium.
Packed with a staggering 15 airtime moments, this coaster famously introduced the world's first non-inverting cobra roll element.
Take the name of a massive South American water boa, remove the 'Ana' from the beginning, and double the final vowel to get this coaster's name.

evidence.quote: Kondaa is a steel roller coaster at Walibi Belgium in Wavre, Belgium.
Kondaa features a top speed of 70.2 mph (113.0 km/h), a notable 15 airtime moments, and the world's first non-inverting cobra roll element.
